lines.text: Google's Gemini app passed six hundred fifty million monthly users.
Five months earlier, it was four hundred million. A quarter of a billion people arrived in under half a year.
Every one of them meets the model inside Google's walls, under Google's rules, in Google's memory not theirs.
The model is magnificent. The room it works in belongs to somebody else.
Six hundred fifty million guests. The house is not theirs.
We track who moves in and teach you to build a room of your own. Follow for the next count.
